# Create issue — `redmine_create_issue`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_write_

Create a new issue (bug, feature, task) in a project with subject, description, tracker, priority, assignee, dates, and custom fields. Returns the created issue with its id.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project_id` | integer | **yes** | Target project id (required). |
| `subject` | string | **yes** | One-line issue summary (required). |
| `tracker_id` | integer | no | Tracker id, e.g. Bug/Feature/Task. NOTE: Redmine silently ignores an unknown id (falls back to the project default) instead of returning a 422 — verify the tracker on the returned issue. |
| `status_id` | integer | no | Initial status id. NOTE: Redmine silently ignores an unknown id (falls back to the default status) instead of returning a 422 — verify the status on the returned issue. |
| `priority_id` | integer | no | Priority id. |
| `description` | string | no | Full description (Textile/Markdown per instance). |
| `assigned_to_id` | integer | no | Assignee user id. |
| `parent_issue_id` | integer | no | Parent issue id, to create this as a sub-task. |
| `start_date` | string | no | Start date, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". |
| `due_date` | string | no | Due date, ISO "YYYY-MM-DD". |
| `done_ratio` | integer | no | Percent done, 0–100 in steps of 10. |
| `estimated_hours` | number | no | Estimated effort in hours. |
| `category_id` | integer | no | Issue category id. |
| `fixed_version_id` | integer | no | Target version (milestone) id. NOTE: Redmine silently ignores an unknown id (or any id when the project has no versions) instead of returning a 422 — verify the version on the returned issue. |
| `is_private` | boolean | no | Mark the issue private. NOTE: applying this depends on your Redmine role permission ("Set issues public/private"). Without it, Redmine silently ignores the flag (the issue stays public) instead of returning an error — verify is_private on the returned issue. |
| `custom_fields` | object[] | no | Custom-field values as { id, value } entries; value may be a string or string[]. |
| `watcher_user_ids` | integer[] | no | User ids to add as watchers. |
| `uploads` | object[] | no | Attachment upload tokens to link to the new issue. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_create_issue",
  "arguments": {
    "project_id": 42,
    "subject": "text",
    "tracker_id": 42
  }
}
```
